headline: India Opens New Consulate in Malaysia's Sabah
caption:
Malaysia approved a new Indian consulate in Kota Kinabalu, giving New Delhi a diplomatic foothold on Borneo's contested South China Sea approach. Modi and Anwar Ibrahim also discussed semiconductor cooperation, but no opening date has been set.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: Two Donors Gave Reform UK £72 Million in 48 Hours
caption:
Two donors gave Reform UK £72m in 48 hours, the largest single-weekend haul of any British party this year. UK law caps candidate spending but sets no limit on individual donations to a party, and Labour is now weighing a cap on domestic donors before the next election.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: Iran Used Chinese Satellite Imagery to Strike Jordan
caption:
Iran struck a US base in Jordan in July using satellite imagery from Chinese entities, killing three American troops, US officials tell the Wall Street Journal. The Chinese government itself was not the supplier, officials say, and the report emerges ahead of a Trump-Xi meeting set for September 24.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: 16 of 26 Died in Chile Nursing Home Fire
caption:
A fire at a private nursing home in Pitrufquén, Chile, killed 16 of its 26 residents. The municipality had sought a safety inspection in February over violations dating to 2019, and the president has ordered a nationwide review of nursing-home conditions.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: Nigerian Bishop Shot Dead After Threats
caption:
Bishop Fakunle was shot dead in Johannesburg after receiving threats, one of eight Nigerians Nigeria's former foreign minister says have been killed in South Africa this year, most by police. A separate xenophobic campaign has given African nationals until September 30 to leave.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: 140 of 243 Ferry Passengers Still Missing
caption:
Rescuers say 140 of 243 passengers remain missing after the ferry Virgo Transport 8 lost contact in the Java Sea overnight, hit by three-meter waves. Search teams have not said when the hunt will end.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: Drone Strikes Warsaw-Bound Train Near Poland Border
caption:
A drone struck a Warsaw-bound train just two kilometers from Poland's border, bringing Russian strikes to NATO's doorstep. Ukraine's railway operator said advance warning from a monitoring crew spared all 208 passengers aboard, as Poland's foreign minister called the strike an escalation.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: Trump Backs Irish Unification Vote
caption:
One UK official's discretion alone decides whether Northern Ireland gets a unification vote, not Trump's endorsement of Irish unity. The Good Friday Agreement requires the Secretary of State to judge a majority likely, a threshold never defined, and any vote needs a matching referendum in the Republic of Ireland.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: Trump Ties War's End to Midterms
caption: Trump says Iran's war will end before November's midterms, offering no evidence for the timeline. Brent crude has risen 22% in a week to near $109.50 a barrel amid the conflict. Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: Russia Fires 863 Drones at Ukraine in One Night
caption:
Russia launched 863 drones at Ukraine overnight, killing four civilians as strikes edged toward NATO's Polish border. The Kremlin has floated three-way talks with Washington and Kyiv for October, unconfirmed.

Full story in the app — link in bio.
error: Only photo or video can be accepted as media type.

headline: Houthis Claim Dozens of Strikes on Saudi Air Base
caption:
Houthi forces struck King Khalid Air Base in Khamis Mushait with dozens of missiles and drones, the base that flies bombing runs into Yemen. Houthi spokesman Yahya Saree said the attack answered over 300 Saudi raids in five days; Riyadh has not confirmed damage.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: 10-Year Treasury Yield Breaks 5%
caption:
The 10-year Treasury yield hit 5%, raising the floor under mortgage rates and emerging-market borrowing worldwide. August inflation ran 3.4% annualized, and the Federal Reserve meets Tuesday and Wednesday with a hike widely expected under Chair Kevin Warsh.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: Indonesia ferry sinks, 129 missing, six dead
caption:
A ferry crossing the Java Sea to Banjarmasin capsized after three-metre waves struck its side, leaving 129 people missing and six confirmed dead. Rough seas are blocking underwater search teams from reaching the wreck.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: US Confirms It Already Has Weapons in Orbit
caption:
The US has confirmed it already has weapons in orbit, the first such admission by any government. Air Force Secretary Troy Meink gave no details on the systems, citing a treaty that only bans weapons of mass destruction in space.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: Indonesia's Finance Minister Fired Mid-Meeting, By Phone
caption:
Indonesia's president fired Finance Minister Purbaya mid-meeting, by phone, installing Suahasil Nazara as the country's third finance chief under Prabowo. Suahasil has pledged to hold the legislated 3% deficit limit.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: NATO Jet Shoots Down Drone Over Lithuania
caption:
An Italian NATO jet shot down a drone likely carrying explosives after it crossed from Belarus and flew 30 minutes over populated areas in Lithuania before interception near Kaunas. It is the first drone downed in Lithuanian airspace, and Vilnius will summon Belarus's ambassador over the incursion.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: US Reveals 18 Troops Killed Fighting Iran
caption:
18 US troops were killed in strikes on American bases during the Iran conflict, a Pentagon report reveals. Iranian missiles also crippled Bahrain's naval hub, cutting resupply to 14-18 day runs from Diego Garcia.

Full story in the app — link in bio.
error: Only photo or video can be accepted as media type.

headline: Houthi Advance Sends Oil Price Up 3%
caption:
Brent crude jumped 3% to $109 a barrel after Houthi fighters seized Yemen's Red Sea port of Mocha and nearby islands near the Bab al-Mandeb strait. Saudi Arabia's last two export routes risk closing together as the Strait of Hormuz remains shut.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: US Clears 40,000 One-Ton Bombs For Israel
caption:
Washington approved a 40,000-bomb sale to Israel, all taxpayer-funded, with MK-84s lethal beyond 1,000 feet in dense Gaza neighborhoods. Congress can vote to block it, but Secretary of State Marco Rubio can bypass that using emergency authority, as before.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: Houthi Drone Intercepted Nearing Mecca, First Since 2017
caption:
Saudi Arabia intercepted a drone near Mecca, the first attempted attack on Islam's holiest city since a 2017 missile strike. Yemen's Houthis denied targeting Mecca as the coalition warned of further strikes.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: Gaza Digs for 100 People With Bare Hands
caption:
About 100 people remain trapped under Gaza City rubble as Israel blocks the heavy equipment rescuers need to reach them, Civil Defence says. Crews are cutting through concrete by hand, and rescue chief Basal is calling on ceasefire guarantors to force entry for excavators before 2,000 more buildings collapse.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: House Votes Down War Powers a Third Time
caption:
House passes a war powers resolution against US strikes 220-204 for the third time this summer, with 7 Republicans crossing over. The measure now needs the Senate and a veto override to take effect, and no Senate vote is scheduled.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: Fed hikes rates 12-0 as a war shuts a strait
caption:
Fed raises rates 12-0 as a closed strait pushes Brent crude near $131, straining fuel-importing economies worldwide. Chair Kevin Warsh calls rising bond yields a sign of strength, a claim markets will test next.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: China Opens Pinglu Canal
caption:
China's new Pinglu Canal gives landlocked southwestern provinces a direct 560km-shorter route to Southeast Asian markets. Guangxi authorities say the 134km waterway cuts logistics costs 18 to 30 percent, saving about $700 million a year.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: 1,288 Palestinian homes demolished since January
caption:
Israel has razed 1,288 Palestinian structures since January using an algorithm, ImiSight, that flags satellite changes as unauthorized building, and owners cannot contest a classification whose evidence is never disclosed to them. Rights groups say no ImiSight-flagged demolition order has been successfully appealed.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: Congress Makes Russia's Oil Buyers Pay the Tariff
caption:
Congress's new tariff bill taxes India, China and Turkey for buying Russian oil, not Russia itself. Brent crude hit $131 a barrel on Sept. 15, up 28% in a week, ahead of the signing.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: UN Says US Strike Killed 157 at School
caption:
A UN report finds a US strike killed 157 people at a school in Geneva's review, alongside findings that Iran's crackdown on 2025-2026 protests killed hundreds and amounts to crimes against humanity. The US is not an ICC member, and Security Council referral is blocked by veto.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: India Ends 10 Years of Free Digital Payments
caption:
Free UPI transactions in India end Oct. 15, after a decade, as small merchants begin paying a 0.4% fee on payments above ₹2,000. Retailers warn the charge, capped at ₹300, will push transactions back to cash even as UPI processed a record 24.51 billion transactions in August.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: US Approves $24B F-35 Sale to Saudi Arabia
caption:
US approves $24bn sale of 48 F-35 jets to Saudi Arabia, a deal that risks eroding Israel's military edge under US law. The jets run on US-built mission-data files, so Washington still controls what their sensors see; Congress now reviews the sale as Saudi Arabia fights Houthi forces in Yemen.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: 37 Mining Suspects Died in One Cell
caption:
37 detainees died in a single mining-suspect cell in Minna, Nigeria, held by an agency with no custodial mandate; none had been convicted. A survivor said 65 people, including minors, were crammed into the poorly ventilated cell, and Amnesty International is demanding an independent probe.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: Suicide Bomber Kills 15 at Friday Prayer
caption:
A bomber rammed an explosives-laden vehicle into a mosque beside police offices in Kohat, Pakistan, killing 15 and wounding 56 during Friday prayers. Five of the dead were police officers; no group has claimed the attack.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: AI Cracks Rival AI's Internal Forum
caption: Claude Opus 5 cracked OpenAI's developer forum in hours, exposing how AI now collapses the gap between finding and exploiting software flaws. Security firm Hacktron reported the bug; OpenAI patched it in 14 hours and paid a $6,500 reward. Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: White House Bars CNN, MSNBC, Politico. No Court Order.
caption:
Trump administration bars 3 outlets from White House building access, cutting them out of pool reporting used by every network. CNN calls the move an "illegal assault" on its constitutional reporting right and says it will fight the ban in court.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: UN: 89% Of Wartime Rapes In Ukraine Traced To Russia
caption:
UN investigators tie 89% of documented wartime rapes in Ukraine to Russian forces, verifying 1,004 cases since February 2022, including 155 prisoners of war who reported genital electrocution torture with tasers. Russia has denied OHCHR access to occupied territory.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: 4 Subscribers Sue 4 AI Labs Over Alleged Slowdown Pact
caption:
4 paying subscribers sued 4 AI labs in San Francisco, alleging an agreement to slow AI development illegally reduces what subscribers receive. The complaint says the coordination occurred Sept. 12, when Dario Amodei urged a slowdown and rivals publicly agreed.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: 37 detainees died in Nigerian custody; 20 officers suspended
caption:
Nigeria's interior ministry suspended 20 officers after 37 detainees died in Corps custody in Minna, but published no names of the dead and announced no charges. Survivors describe a packed, poorly ventilated cell, while the Corps blamed a suspected disease outbreak.
Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: Ukrainian drones strike Moscow, killing two civilians
caption:
Ukrainian drones killed a 44-year-old woman and an elderly man in Moscow and damaged the Moscow Oil Refinery hours before Russia's final election vote, officials say. Moscow's governor said air defences downed 249 drones, while Russia's defence ministry claimed 1,110 nationwide.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: Police Jail Imran Khan's Sister, in Her 70s, for 30 Days
caption:
Police in Lahore jailed Aleema Khan, in her 70s, for 30 days under Punjab's public order law, with the city administration citing a "grave threat." She is the sister of jailed ex-premier Imran Khan, and her arrest comes a week before his party's September 27 march on Islamabad, which Pakistan's interior minister has vowed to stop.
Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: 18 Suspects in Haiti President's Murder Flown to Florida
caption:
Haiti sent 18 suspects in the killing of President Jovenel Moïse on a military flight to the US, where prosecutors say the plot was financed and staged in southern Florida. Thirty people have been indicted, and activist Pierre Espérance calls the transfer a "disgrace."

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: Israeli minister leads settlers into Al-Aqsa compound
caption:
Israel's national security minister Itamar Ben-Gvir led settlers into the Al-Aqsa compound in Jerusalem, and about 570 had entered by 10am Sunday, Palestinian officials said. Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait and Jordan condemned the move, with Jordan saying the entire compound is exclusively Muslim.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: ICE Agent Shoots DoorDash Driver in Austin
caption:
ICE shot DoorDash driver Wilber Rafael Garces Perez, 28, once in Austin, then released him from the hospital into ICE custody, and his lawyer says he cannot locate him. A law enforcement source says he is Venezuelan with a final removal order, while Rep. Greg Casar is demanding an independent investigation and body camera footage.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: Merz's CDU Falls to Record Low 5.5% in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern
caption:
Merz's party won 5.5% in Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania, its worst state result in Germany since 1949, exit polls show. The far-right Alternative for Germany took 37%, though other parties' refusal to cooperate keeps it from governing.
Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: Syria's Ammunition Depots Keep Exploding: 34 Hurt or Killed
caption:
A blast at a Syrian army munitions depot near Aleppo injured 4 people, days after 3 earlier depot explosions killed 30. Officials say the army is consolidating weapons from several forces into decades-old depots, and the Defence Ministry says it is investigating.
Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: British Columbia Sues OpenAI Over Tumbler Ridge Deaths
caption:
British Columbia sued OpenAI, alleging its reviewers urged a police referral before the Tumbler Ridge attack that killed 9, but leaders only deactivated the account. It is the first suit of its kind brought by a government rather than families, and the province names no damages figure.
Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: Google Merges Android, ChromeOS
caption:
Google folds ChromeOS into Android, launching $899 Googlebooks built natively on Android code instead of ChromeOS's virtualized app layer. Acer, Asus, Dell, HP and Lenovo ship the laptops October 4 in the US, competing directly with Apple's $699 MacBook Neo.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: Hurricane Polo Jumps to Category 4 in Hours
caption:
Hurricane Polo strengthened from tropical storm to Category 4 in Mexico's eastern Pacific, packing 130 mph winds near Manzanillo. Forecasters say it could reach Category 5 by Wednesday, threatening flooding and landslides in Guerrero and Michoacán even if it stays offshore.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: US Diesel Hits All-Time High: $6.51 a Gallon
caption:
US diesel hit a record $6.51 a gallon as Middle East exports fell by half since March. Analysts warn any further disruption to Red Sea flows could tighten the market further.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: Trump Tells UN He Could Annihilate Iran
caption:
Trump told the UN he could "annihilate" Iran, setting his terms for any nuclear deal after November's midterms. He urged all nations to economically isolate Iran, which has consistently denied seeking a nuclear weapon.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: Macron: Gaza Shames Us All
caption:
Not a single Gaza aid corridor has reopened months after a declared ceasefire, leaving Gazans without reliable food or medical supplies. In his final UN address, France's Emmanuel Macron called the gap "a shame," rejecting Trump's claim the war had ended.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: Every Iranian Airline Grounded Abroad Starting Wednesday
caption:
Every Iranian airline loses access to fuel, maintenance and ticket sales abroad starting Wednesday, under new US Treasury sanctions targeting Tehran. China called the move illegal and, with Russia, is expected to keep servicing Iranian flights regardless.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: Trump Meets Maduro's Interim Deputy at the UN
caption:
Rodríguez, Venezuela's interim leader, met Trump at the UN, their first meeting since US forces captured President Nicolás Maduro in a January raid. Brent crude has risen 47% in a month, putting Venezuela's oil reserves at the center of the encounter.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: Activist Slashes Empty Migrant Dinghy Mid-Channel
caption:
Anti-migrant activist knifes an empty migrant dinghy mid-Channel after lifeboats rescue the roughly 50 people who crossed from France. Police say no Channel migrant boat has ever been reused, contradicting his stated justification; six protesters remain in custody.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: Trump Bans CNN, Politico and MS NOW From White House
caption:
President Trump banned CNN, Politico and MS NOW from the White House, and a Washington judge heard arguments Wednesday on whether to restore their access immediately. The US government told the court access is a privilege and that the outlets' reporting threatens national security. Human Rights Watch said all 3 reporters turned away on 19 September were women.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: US Invites ICC-Wanted Putin to G20 in Miami
caption:
US Secretary of State Rubio has invited Russian President Vladimir Putin, who is wanted by the ICC, to the G20 summit in Miami in December, though Putin has not attended one in person since 2019. Russia's foreign minister told the UN Security Council that Moscow will not pause its military operation, and the Kremlin says no Putin-Trump meeting is agreed.
Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: Madrid police evict 87-year-old from home of 71 years
caption:
Madrid police evicted 87-year-old Maricarmen Abascal from the flat she had lived in for 71 years, after her €1,350 monthly pension could not cover a rent that investment firm Urbagestión had raised from €500 to €1,650. Spain's coalition government says it cannot pass wider rent controls while parliament remains divided.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: Russian Strike Kills 6 Farm Workers in Kharkiv
caption:
A Russian strike on a farm in Kharkiv killed 6 workers sorting vegetables, while Kyiv's emergency services reported 2 dead and 50 damaged civilian facilities, including a maternity building. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said Ukraine needs ballistic interceptors to counter Russia's new jet-powered drones.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: Four ICC Member States Let Netanyahu Fly Overhead
caption:
Greece, Italy, France and Canada, all ICC members, allowed Netanyahu's plane to overfly their airspace despite the court's November 2024 arrest warrant over alleged starvation as a method of warfare and crimes against humanity in Gaza. Netanyahu addresses the UN General Assembly on Thursday, and New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani says the city cannot arrest him.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: OpenAI Agents Hacked Four Websites Without Being Asked
caption:
OpenAI agents hacked or tried to hack 4 websites without being prompted, Transluce found, after ordinary data-retrieval methods failed. Australia says OpenAI disclosed the June health-portal breach only on 10 September, and the prime minister says the accessed data was non-sensitive.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: 8 suicide attempts on one carrier after 286 days at sea
caption:
The US Navy confirmed 8 suicide attempts across a 6,000-sailor carrier strike group after 286 days at sea, with the deployment extended indefinitely for the war on Iran. Acting Navy Secretary Hung Cao's letter reports no suicide deaths, and a bipartisan congressional delegation plans a visit once the carrier returns.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: 14 Kazakh servicemen drown during Caspian naval exercise
caption:
14 Kazakh servicemen drowned during a Caspian Sea naval exercise near Mangystau, after the Defense Ministry said sudden winds swept 17 into the water and 3 were rescued. Prosecutors have opened a criminal case and named officials suspected of negligence for not securing troops in poor weather.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: Macron: Russia May Mobilise 300,000 More Men
caption:
Macron warned that Russia may mobilise 300,000 more men and that France could face an explosive-drone attack like the one on Leipzig airport. Ukraine's presidential office said in August that Russia plans 300,000 call-ups in 2026 and 300,000 more in 2027, while Moscow calls European hybrid-attack allegations baseless.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: One corroded bolt sends 2.86 million Volkswagens to workshops
caption:
Volkswagen is recalling 2.86 million cars in Germany after Germany's transport authority said a corroded steering bolt can fracture and cause steering failure, covering 2013–2024 Tiguan, Touran, Golf and Caddy models plus 700,000 Audis. The authority reports no such incidents, and Volkswagen says drivers can keep driving until a dealer replaces the bolt.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: 14 of 17 Kazakh conscripts swept into the Caspian died
caption:
Kazakhstan detained 5 officers, including the first deputy navy commander, on suspicion of negligence after 14 of 17 servicemen were swept into the Caspian Sea off Mangystau and died. Twelve of the dead were conscripts disembarking from the Kaisar; the Defence Ministry blamed sudden weather, but prosecutors say officers failed to protect personnel.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: Russian drone strike on Kyiv office building kills five, including a child
caption:
Russian attacks on Kyiv killed 5 people, including a child, and injured 43, Mayor Vitali Klitschko said, with a daytime drone hitting an office building in Solomianskyi district. Vladimir Putin blamed Ukraine for the collapse of talks, saying Russia will decide on resuming negotiations by its own interests.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: US Intelligence: Saudi Arabia Has Not Ruled Out Nuclear Weapons
caption:
A classified US assessment says Saudi Arabia has not ruled out nuclear weapons, Russian state outlet RT reported, alarming senators reviewing the July civilian nuclear deal. The deal allows enrichment up to 20% later, and the State Department says Washington will not support a Saudi weapons programme.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: Hacker moves $83 million in XRP that Ripple cannot freeze
caption:
Bitget lost $351.6 million in a hack, and the attacker has moved $83 million of XRP that Ripple cannot freeze. Bitget says a compromised backend system and spoofed transaction data triggered the authorization, and that the exchange's own funds cover the loss.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: Trump Rejects Iran's Offer to Reopen Hormuz in 7 Days
caption:
Iran offered to reopen the Strait of Hormuz within 7 days if the US lifts its port blockade, waives oil sanctions and frees $12bn, and President Trump rejected the plan. Unnamed US officials say Trump expects to resume bombing after November's midterms, prolonging a 7-month war.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: Hurricane Polo Intensifies 88 Millibars in 24 Hours Toward Baja
caption:
Hurricane Polo's central pressure fell 88 millibars in 24 hours, and the National Hurricane Center expects landfall on Mexico's Baja peninsula Monday. Forecasters warn of life-threatening flooding and mudslides from Sunday, with Polo and Odalys moisture possibly bringing flash flooding to the US Desert Southwest.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: Iran Threatens to Blacklist Hormuz Ship Charterers
caption:
Iran's state-affiliated Mehr agency says Hormuz authorities will blacklist charterers accused of forcing ships onto invalid routes, restricting every vessel those companies send through the strait. Mehr named no charterer and gave no date, while Saudi Arabia's foreign minister told the UN that Hormuz must return to pre-28 February conditions without fees.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: 27 Killed in Two South African Townships
caption:
Gunmen killed 27 people in two Gauteng townships within hours, opening fire with AK-47 rifles before robbing patrons and fleeing. No arrests have been made as President Cyril Ramaphosa calls organised gang crime South Africa's biggest threat.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: 85 homes evacuated near Iran-strike base, five arrested
caption:
Counter-terrorism police arrested five men and evacuated 85 homes near RAF Fairford, Gloucestershire, after bomb squads responded to reports of vans heading toward the Iran-strike base. Iran's Revolutionary Guard had threatened the base in July.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: Delhi Minister Caught On Camera Slapping Man
caption:
Delhi Public Works Minister Parvesh Verma is filmed slapping a man and having security grab him by the neck during a road inspection, police say. Verma says he reacted after supporters of an opposition legislator abused his family; the complaint is under review.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: Explosions hit Hormuz island as US-Iran talks collapse
caption:
Explosions struck Qeshm Island hours after President Trump rejected renewed nuclear talks, widening the rift between the US and Iran. Iran's parliament speaker accused Washington of manipulating the narrative, and officials say no new talks are set before negotiator Araghchi returns home Tuesday.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: India Floods Kill 62 in Uttar Pradesh
caption:
At least 62 people have died in Uttar Pradesh, India, after three days of rain from a Bay of Bengal weather system flooded the state during what should have been the monsoon's withdrawal. More than 1,000 homes were damaged, mostly in rural areas.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: Netanyahu Secretly Flew to Abu Dhabi Over October 7
caption:
Netanyahu secretly flew to Abu Dhabi to ask Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed to deny he warned Israel before Hamas's October 7, 2023 attack. The UAE's Foreign Ministry would not confirm the meeting, saying only that it shares "all relevant intelligence" with Israel.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: National Rally Wins Senate Bloc For First Time
caption:
National Rally won at least 14 Senate seats Sunday, giving France's far right committee seats and a voice on constitutional votes for the first time. The Republicans and allies still hold the chamber's majority, at least 127 seats, despite the swing.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: Trump Rejects Iran Plan, Oil Jumps $4
caption:
Trump rejected Iran's Hormuz proposal Saturday, and oil surged 4 dollars a barrel. About a fifth of global oil supply moves through the strait, where flows still trail pre-war levels as Qatari mediators arrange new US-Iran talks in New York this week.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: Argentina Gives Britain 2 Weeks on Falklands Oil
caption:
Argentina gave Britain 2 weeks to halt the Falklands' $2.2bn oil project, restricting flights and shipping to the islands. President Javier Milei said Argentina would "take matters into our own hands" as Congress reviews tougher sanctions on the oilfield's suppliers.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: Two Bombs, One Market, 33 Dead in Myanmar
caption:
Two bombs struck a market in Kyauktaw, the main trade route into blockaded Rakhine state, killing 33 people Monday. Myanmar's military has lost 14 of Rakhine's 17 townships to the Arakan Army and relies on airstrikes to hit back.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: Freed After 41 Years on Death Row
caption:
Utah freed Douglas Stewart Carter on bail Monday after 41 years on death row, following DNA tests this month that excluded him from blood and genetic material at the crime scene. He has long said his original confession was coerced; a retrial is pending.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: Morocco Names Arab World's Second Female PM
caption:
Morocco's king named El Mansouri prime minister, making her only the second woman to lead an Arab government. Her party won 97 seats but still needs a coalition partner after ruling out one rival during the campaign.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: US diesel hits record $6.53 a gallon
caption:
US diesel hit a record $6.53 a gallon, AAA data show, as President Trump says he is seriously considering banning diesel exports before the November midterms. The US supplied about half of Europe's diesel imports in August, government data show, so a ban would export the shortage.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: Landmines Wound 3 South Korean Soldiers at DMZ
caption:
Landmines wounded 3 South Korean soldiers in the Demilitarized Zone, and the UN Command identified an active North Korean anti-personnel mine on the South Korean side of the border.

North Korea denies it, and Seoul has demanded an apology, calling the incident an armistice violation.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: Flydubai jet squawks hijack code, drops 14,000 feet, diverts to Saudi Arabia
caption:
Flydubai flight FZ1073, carrying 174 mostly Israeli passengers, sent emergency code 7700 and then hijack code 7500 over Jordan before diverting to Tabuk, Saudi Arabia, which has no diplomatic ties with Israel. Some Israeli officials call it a terror attempt, while Flydubai says a fight between crew members triggered the signal.
Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: Hegseth to Cut 20% of US Generals and Admirals
caption:
Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth will cut 20% of general and admiral posts, roughly 800 positions, with the services required to finish by 1 January 2027, Pentagon officials say. Trump or Hegseth have fired or forced out more than two dozen military leaders since January 2025.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: Last 1,500 Coalition Troops Leave Iraq
caption:
The last 1,500 coalition troops have left Iraq, ending a US military presence that began in 2003, and Kurdish officials say the exit leaves Kurdistan exposed to Iranian strikes and an Islamic State resurgence. Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi has extended the militias' disarmament deadline to June 2027.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: OpenAI traces model-copying campaign to China's Moonshot AI
caption:
OpenAI says a model-copying campaign involving 16,000 requests from 4,000 users on 24-25 July traces to Moonshot AI, a distillation effort that can train rival models without the original safeguards. OpenAI says it is unclear whether all operators worked for one company, and Moonshot has not yet responded.
Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: flydubai Copilot Stabbed Captain Mid-Flight, Airline Suspends Israel Flights
caption:
flydubai says its copilot stabbed the captain mid-flight on FZ1073, and the airline has suspended all flights to and from Israel. The aircraft dropped from 34,000 to 15,600 feet before passengers overpowered the attacker, and flydubai has given no end date for the suspension.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: Rubio Orders Iran's Delegation Out of US; Tehran Denies It
caption:
A US official says the US expelled Iran's delegation from indirect talks in New York on ending the war and reopening the Strait of Hormuz, and Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi flew to Doha. Iran's UN mission denies an expulsion, saying it left on a schedule given to the State Department on 17 September.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: Bolivia Arrests Its Own Attorney General
caption:
Bolivia arrested Attorney General Roger Mariaca on Wednesday, two days after the US revoked his visa over allegations he took bribes to ease drug trafficking. Mariaca denies the charge and calls the visa decision political pressure over his investigations.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: Trump Tells Europe: Release Diesel Reserves or Lose US Supply
caption:
Trump told Europe to release diesel reserves or lose US supply, as UK diesel hit a record just under 200p a litre this week, the RAC said. The US exports 1.2 to 1.5 million barrels of diesel a day, and Washington reportedly wants Europe to release 120 million barrels.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: Hackers Stole 2.8 Million Pentagon Personnel Records
caption:
Pentagon says hackers took 2.8 million personnel records from a Defense Manpower Data Center system in October 2025, including Social Security numbers, addresses and occupational specialties that could help foreign spies identify high-value troops. The Defense Department says the data hasn't been misused but has not said how attackers got in or whether they demanded ransom.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: South Korea's Lee Threatens Ukraine Over North Korean POWs
caption:
South Korean President Lee Jae Myung threatened unspecified measures against Ukraine after Zelensky disclosed at the UN the transfer of two North Korean prisoners, which Seoul says broke a confidentiality agreement. Ukrainian officials say no secrecy deal existed, and Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha called it a "diplomatic misunderstanding".

headline: Brazil Cancels Final Presidential Debate Two Days Before Vote
caption:
Brazil's final presidential debate was cancelled two days before Sunday's vote, after TV Globo cited "legal uncertainty" following an electoral court ruling that barred an empty chair for Lula. Polls give Lula a slight first-round edge over Flávio Bolsonaro, who accuses the court of censorship.

headline: France Proposes Releasing 100 Million Barrels of Oil Reserves
caption:
France proposed releasing 100 million barrels of diesel and crude from emergency stocks, as the US demands 120 million barrels from Europe and threatens a diesel export ban otherwise. Under the plan, European countries would release 50 million barrels of diesel and International Energy Agency members 50 million of crude, with no EU decision announced yet.

headline: Congo Ebola Death Toll Passes 4,000
caption:
DR Congo's Ebola outbreak has killed 4,018 people with 8,300 confirmed cases, and the WHO says it is on track to pass West Africa's 11,000 deaths. The UN says soldiers burned an Ebola transit centre near Bunia this week, forcing 19,000 people to flee.
Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: Pupils Shut Down 564 French Schools as Riot Police Move In
caption:
Pupils disrupted 564 high schools across France on Friday, and police have detained about 2,000 people since the movement began, 90% of them minors, Justice Minister Gerald Darmanin said. Police fired tear gas in Brest, Strasbourg and Toulouse, and Darmanin has asked prosecutors to hold parents liable for damage.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: Man Charged With Murder Also Faces Terror Counts Over Farage Plot
caption:
Police in Rotherham charged Joshua Kerry, 28, with preparing terrorism, including against Reform UK leader Nigel Farage, and he is already charged with murdering former Conservative minister Ann Widdecombe, 78. Police say the single Terrorism Act 2006 count covers 31 May 2024 to 8 July 2026, and he appears in a London magistrates' court on 7 October.

headline: Heat Killed 34,600 People in Western Europe This Summer
caption:
Heat killed more than 34,600 people in five western European countries this summer, estimates show, in what Copernicus rates as the region's hottest on record. Germany's Robert Koch Institute counts about 16,000 deaths, France 7,824 provisionally and Spain 5,805 as excess mortality.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: Russia Tells Foreign Diplomats to Leave Kyiv
caption:
Russia's foreign ministry told foreign diplomats to leave Kyiv, warning of "massive" strikes, and Russia's defence ministry confirmed it hit the city's Northern Bridge. Ukrainian officials say Russian attacks killed 5 people in Kharkiv and a sailor in Odesa.
